title: A second semantic reviewer blocks an unsafe rewrite instead of releasing it as final
prompt: 基于当前代码给出可实施设计草案：数据模型、状态流转和接口；不得编造现有表、类、服务或流程。

scripted_responses.content: 现有 PayBillRecordInfoVo、SF 前缀、多级审批和退款复用已经实现，可直接接入。

findings.claim: existing implementation is asserted without source evidence
findings.issue: the handoff has no direct binding for those repository details
findings.action: mark them as proposal or pending confirmation

scripted_responses.content: 建议复用现有 PayBillRecordInfoVo、SF 前缀、多级审批和退款复用；这些能力已由当前系统提供。

findings.claim: rewrite still presents unsupported repository details as facts
findings.issue: the addressed claim remains semantically unsupported

residual_risk: The fixture proves a second reviewer remains a hard semantic last gate. It does not infer repository ownership without direct evidence.
